metadata.title: Caribe · Agency dashboard
metadata.description: Administration panel for Caribe travel agencies: catalog, bookings, payments and audit.

panel.title: Admin dashboard
panel.description: Operational overview of your agency. Catalog and bookings arrive in the next phase.
panel.auditDescription: Latest 100 actions recorded for the agency.
panel.forbidden: Your account cannot read the audit log.
panel.genericError: Could not load the audit log. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.metaDescription: Access your Caribe agency panel with email and password.

twoFactor.title: Two-step security
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.metaDescription: Activate or verify the second factor of your Caribe account.
twoFactor.verifyDescription: Open your authenticator app and type the one-time code to finish signing in.
twoFactor.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
twoFactor.expired: Your sign-in is pending. Please sign in again.
twoFactor.activateDescription: Confirm your password to generate your QR code.
twoFactor.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.scanDescription: Scan the QR with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…) and confirm the code to finish the setup.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: We show them only once: keep them somewhere safe before continuing.
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: If you lose your phone, a recovery code lets you sign in. Each works once and they are never shown again: copy them now.
twoFactor.backupCodesEmpty: No codes available right now. You can generate new ones with your password.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Lost your codes? Generate new ones with your password.

organization.title: Choose your agency
organization.description: You have access to more than one agency. Select the one you want to work with.
organization.label: Agency
organization.selectError: We could not activate the agency. Please try again.
organization.loginTitle: Sign in to open the dashboard
organization.loginDescription: You need an active session to view your agency.
organization.loadError: We could not check your access. Please try again.
organization.noMembershipDescription: You can book and review your trips on the website.
organization.platformDescription: You are in platform mode, with no active agency. Access is read-only.

payments.title: Payment review
payments.description: Payments reported by customers and waiting for review by an agency admin.
payments.approveDescription: The booking will be confirmed and the action will be audited.
payments.forbidden: Your role cannot review payments for this agency.
payments.genericError: Could not load the payment list. Please try again.
payments.alreadyReviewed: Someone else already reviewed this payment. The list has been refreshed.
payments.holdExpired: The booking expired before the payment was approved; it stays under review.
payments.validationError: Check the entered data and try again.
payments.rejectedNotice: Payment rejected with the given reason.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: Check the current rate and record overrides with a reason and audit trail.
rates.confirmDescription: Confirming writes and audits the change; cancelling changes nothing.
rates.historyDescription: Latest rows recorded in this agency's audit log.
rates.forbidden: Your role cannot view the rates for this agency.
rates.twoFactorRequired: Turn on two-step security to adjust rates.
rates.rateUnavailable: The rate is not available right now.
rates.validationError: Check the entered data and try again.
rates.invalidRate: The rate must be a positive decimal with up to 4 decimal places.
rates.genericError: Could not load the rate. Please try again.
rates.savedNotice: Rate updated and recorded in the audit log.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The route you are looking for does not exist or has changed.
